note: Tennessee State Parks, Rocky Top, near the west end of Norris Dam. Ridge-top loop of water and electric sites in the woods; bathhouse and playground. The park warns that the one-mile road up to the campground is steep with dangerous curves. --Claude
summary: West Campground: camping page, 2026-05 campground map, reservation calendar (5 windows Dec 2026-Sep 2027), Esri.
